summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, reporting its Q1 2026 financial results. The filing includes sales of $2.0 billion (up 14% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $412 million (up 15% YoY), and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.11 (up 22% YoY). The company increased its full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance from $1.4-$1.6 billion to $1.5-$1.7 billion. This is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a domestic earnings release, and does not constitute a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate action typically classified by event-driven analysts.
